name: QE Soundboard — Act 2: Meeting Carrone
description: Click a sound to play it for everyone.

sounds.name: SFX: Pacific Towers bar, late morning (loop)
Lobby guard: he's at the bar
sounds.description: [a little too polite, avoiding eye contact] Morning. [beat] Mister Carrone? He's, uh... by the bar. Table on the left. [nervous] He's expecting you.

sounds.name: Carrone: order something
sounds.description: [without looking up] You came. Good. [beat] Order something. [dry] Trust me, you'll want it.

sounds.name: SFX: door locked, white noise generator
Carrone: who he is
sounds.description: [measured] Robert Carrone. [beat] Vice president at MegaMedia, in charge of Euphoria's career. [pause] Before the contract, I was her manager. For years. [quietly] So you understand. This one is personal.

sounds.name: Carrone: let's not waste time
sounds.description: [brusque] Let's not waste each other's time. [crisp] Euphoria is missing. [beat] Again. [measured] MegaMedia wants her back — [pause] and I'm told you're discreet.

sounds.name: Carrone: I know what you did
sounds.description: [cold, measured] I know exactly who took her the first time. [pause] The only question is whether you're going to be useful to me now.

sounds.name: Carrone: the late Mr. Whitecastle
sounds.description: [cool] Your employer has settled its debt with us. [beat] So has your friend, Mister Whitecastle. [pause] [glancing at a watch, almost pleasant] Forgive me. [beat] So did the late Mister Whitecastle.

sounds.name: Carrone: the terms
sounds.description: [businesslike] Twenty thousand nuyen. Each. [beat] Bring her back before six a.m. Saturday. [pause] After that, it's half. [flat] Do it, and MegaMedia forgets the first time. Refuse... [beat] and I can only promise you what Mister Whitecastle got.

sounds.name: Carrone: name your price
sounds.description: [cold, precise] Find her. Quietly. [pause] Before the press does. [beat] [smooth] Name your price... [dry] within reason.

sounds.name: Carrone: secrecy and reports
sounds.description: [cold] Two conditions. [beat] Not one word of this reaches the press. Not a whisper. [pause] And I want a full report every eight hours. [firmly] No exceptions.

sounds.name: Carrone: don't disappoint me
sounds.description: [pleasantly] MegaMedia has a long memory — and a very large legal department. [beat] Don't disappoint me.

sounds.name: Carrone: come up to the condo
sounds.description: [standing] Come. Her condo. [beat] Nothing has been touched since we found her gone. [pause] I'd like you to see it before anyone else does.

sounds.name: Newscast: Whitecastle firebombed (back on the street)
sounds.description: [news-anchor delivery] In local news, fire crews were called before dawn to a residence in the north metroplex, where a firebomb gutted a private home. [beat] One body was recovered from the scene. [pause] Lone Star has identified the victim, through dental records, as Ellery Whitecastle, a local businessman. [beat] Investigators have not named a suspect, and are asking anyone with information to come forward.
